30	 * Spring Data JPA specialization of the {@link OwnerRepository} interface
31	 *
32	 * @author Michael Isvy

36	@Profile("spring-data-jpa")
37	public interface SpringDataOwnerRepository extends OwnerRepository, Repository<Owner, Integer> {
38	
39	    @Override
40	    @Query("SELECT DISTINCT owner FROM Owner owner left join fetch owner.pets WHERE owner.lastName LIKE :lastName%")

42	
43	    @Override
44	    @Query(
45	        value = "SELECT owner FROM Owner owner WHERE owner.lastName LIKE CONCAT(:lastName, '%')",
46	        countQuery = "SELECT COUNT(owner) FROM Owner owner WHERE owner.lastName LIKE CONCAT(:lastName, '%')")
47	    Page<Owner> findByLastName(@Param("lastName") String lastName, Pageable pageable);
48	
49	    @Override
50	    @Query(
51	        value = "SELECT owner FROM Owner owner",
52	        countQuery = "SELECT COUNT(owner) FROM Owner owner")
53	    Page<Owner> findAll(Pageable pageable);
54	
55	    @Override
56	    @Query("SELECT owner FROM Owner owner left join fetch owner.pets WHERE owner.id =:id")
57	    Owner findById(@Param("id") int id);
58	}
